none: PAS NLM-130DF2: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CO[---]IVN[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [G]LOR IAEXERCITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 1.75gms, die axis: 12
